name: plateforme-mobilite
description: Plateforme de mobilité et de réservation de transport — backend/API et interface d'administration

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/admin
scripts.install:mobile: npm --prefix apps/mobile-client install && npm --prefix apps/mobile-driver install
scripts.typecheck:mobile: npm --prefix apps/mobile-client run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile-driver run typecheck
